def simulate(add_targets={}):
    total_sell_gross = 0.0
    for c in sell_all_codes:
        amt = holdings[c]["shares"] * holdings[c]["close_price"]
        total_sell_gross += amt
        print(f"SELL_ALL {c}: {holdings[c]['shares']} sh @ {holdings[c]['close_price']} = {amt:,.0f} ({holdings[c]['tradable_weight']*100:.2f}%)")
    
    for c, tw in trim_targets.items():
        price = holdings[c]["close_price"]
        curr_sh = holdings[c]["shares"]
        target_val = tw * nav
        # Usually target shares = floor(target_val / (price * 1000)) * 1000 or round
        target_sh_floor = int(target_val // (price * 1000)) * 1000
        sell_sh = curr_sh - target_sh_floor
        amt = sell_sh * price
        total_sell_gross += amt
        print(f"TRIM {c} -> {tw*100:.2f}%: sell {sell_sh} sh @ {price} = {amt:,.0f} (exact diff: {(holdings[c]['tradable_weight']-tw)*nav:,.0f})")

    total_buy_gross = 0.0
    for c, (tw, price) in buy_targets.items():
        target_val = tw * nav
        buy_sh = int(target_val // (price * 1000)) * 1000
        amt = buy_sh * price
        total_buy_gross += amt
        print(f"BUY {c} -> {tw*100:.2f}%: buy {buy_sh} sh @ {price} = {amt:,.0f} (exact: {target_val:,.0f})")

    for c, tw in add_targets.items():
        price = holdings[c]["close_price"]
        curr_sh = holdings[c]["shares"]
        target_val = tw * nav
        target_sh = int(target_val // (price * 1000)) * 1000
        buy_sh = max(0, target_sh - curr_sh)
        amt = buy_sh * price
        total_buy_gross += amt
        print(f"ADD {c} -> {tw*100:.2f}%: buy {buy_sh} sh @ {price} = {amt:,.0f} (exact diff: {(tw-holdings[c]['tradable_weight'])*nav:,.0f})")

    sell_fee = total_sell_gross * 0.004425
    buy_fee = total_buy_gross * 0.001425
    end_cash = cash + (total_sell_gross - sell_fee) - (total_buy_gross + buy_fee)
    end_nav = nav - sell_fee - buy_fee
    end_cash_ratio = end_cash / end_nav

    print("-" * 50)
    print(f"Total Sell Gross: {total_sell_gross:,.2f} ({total_sell_gross/nav*100:.3f}% of NAV)")
    print(f"Total Buy Gross : {total_buy_gross:,.2f} ({total_buy_gross/nav*100:.3f}% of NAV)")
    print(f"Diff (Buy - Sell): {total_buy_gross - total_sell_gross:,.2f} ({(total_buy_gross - total_sell_gross)/nav*100:.3f}% of NAV)")

# Verification assertions
prev_set = set(holdings.keys())
dec_tickers = [d["ticker"] for d in decisions]
nt_tickers = [n["ticker"] for n in no_trade_decisions]

# 1. No duplicates
assert len(dec_tickers) == len(set(dec_tickers)), "Duplicate in decisions"
assert len(nt_tickers) == len(set(nt_tickers)), "Duplicate in no_trade_decisions"
assert set(dec_tickers).isdisjoint(set(nt_tickers)), "Overlap between decisions and no_trade_decisions"

# 2. Exact coverage of yesterday's 24 holdings
covered_prev = (set(dec_tickers) & prev_set) | set(nt_tickers)
assert covered_prev == prev_set, f"Missing or extra prev holdings: {prev_set ^ covered_prev}"
for n in no_trade_decisions:
    assert n["ticker"] in prev_set, f"Non-holding in no_trade: {n['ticker']}"

# 3. Action consistency with prev holdings
for d in decisions:
    if d["action"] == "BUY":
        assert d["ticker"] not in prev_set
        assert d["target_weight"] > 0
        assert d["funding_for"] is None
    elif d["action"] in ("TRIM", "ADD"):
        assert d["ticker"] in prev_set
        assert d["target_weight"] > 0
    elif d["action"] == "SELL_ALL":
        assert d["ticker"] in prev_set
        assert d["target_weight"] == 0.0

# 4. Reference IDs & length limits
buy_ids = {d["decision_id"] for d in decisions if d["action"] in ("BUY", "ADD")}
for d in decisions:
    assert len(d["inference_refs"]) >= 1
    assert set(d["inference_refs"]).issubset(valid_inferences)
    assert len(d["risk_check"]) <= 300
    if d["funding_for"] is not None:
        assert d["action"] in ("TRIM", "SELL_ALL")
        assert set(d["funding_for"]).issubset(buy_ids)

for n in no_trade_decisions:
    assert len(n["reason_refs"]) >= 1
    assert set(n["reason_refs"]).issubset(valid_inferences)
    assert len(n["reason"]) <= 300

# 5. Final holdings count & single stock weight limits
active_decisions = [d for d in decisions if d["target_weight"] > 0]
final_count = len(active_decisions) + len(no_trade_decisions)
assert 20 <= final_count <= 30, f"Final count {final_count} out of range"
for d in active_decisions:
    limit = 0.25 if d["ticker"] == "2330" else 0.10
    assert d["target_weight"] <= limit
for n in no_trade_decisions:
    limit = 0.25 if n["ticker"] == "2330" else 0.10
    assert holdings[n["ticker"]]["tradable_weight"] <= limit
